fallbackDestination.description:
This is the fallback destination an inbound call will be transferred to if:
1. `assistantId` is not set
2. `squadId` is not set
3. and, `assistant-request` message to the `serverUrl` fails

If this is not set and above conditions are met, the inbound call is hung up with an error message.

hooks.description: This is the hooks that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.

name.description: This is the name of the phone number. This is just for your own reference.

assistantId.description:
This is the assistant that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.

If neither `assistantId`, `squadId` nor `workflowId` is set, `assistant-request` will be sent to your Server URL. Check `ServerMessage` and `ServerMessageResponse` for the shape of the message and response that is expected.

workflowId.description:
This is the workflow that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.

If neither `assistantId`, `squadId`, nor `workflowId` is set, `assistant-request` will be sent to your Server URL. Check `ServerMessage` and `ServerMessageResponse` for the shape of the message and response that is expected.

server.description:
This is where Vapi will send webhooks. You can find all webhooks available along with their shape in ServerMessage schema.

The order of precedence is:

1. assistant.server
2. phoneNumber.server
3. org.server

number.description: These are the digits of the phone number you own on your Vonage.

credentialId.description: This is the credential you added in dashboard.vapi.ai/keys. This is used to configure the number to send inbound calls to Vapi, make outbound calls and do live call updates like transfers and hangups.
